_comment: Read fresh on every run -- edit freely, no launchd reload needed.
_volume_allowlist: Empty = act on any external ejectable volume under /Volumes. Add names (e.g. ["Extreme SSD"]) to narrow it. Internal and boot disks are refused regardless.
_protected_processes: Never signalled. Spotlight/fseventsd/backupd release on their own once the forced unmount lands; killing them causes reindexing and broken Time Machine state for no benefit.
_graceful_handlers: Per-process overrides. 'pre' runs before SIGTERM (checkpoint/flush), 'wait' is the grace period in seconds. rqbit gets 20s so it can write out its torrent session state.
_escalation: SIGTERM -> (if it holds on) diskutil unmount force -> eject. SIGKILL is never sent unless you pass --force. Forced unmount flushes the filesystem and takes the volume away without destroying the app's in-flight state, so it is the better middle rung.
_debounce_seconds: Finder fires several unmount solicitations per click; only the first is acted on.
